entities.summary: Karl Friedrich Adolf Boser (1811–1881) was a German artist. He studied in Dresden, Berlin, and Düsseldorf; his paintings, chiefly genre subjects and portraits, were popular. He is associated with the Düsseldorf school of painting. Friedrich Boser was a authors & novelists from Iłowa (1809-11-13, Iłowa–1881-01-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
